hints.title: Key Insight and Observation
hints.text: A subset of integers is valid if its cumulative product has no squared prime factors.

hints.title: Algorithmic Strategy and State
hints.text: Factor each unique number into a bitmask of its prime factors up to 30.

hints.title: Optimal Boundary and Processing
hints.text: Use bitmask state transitions to find the maximum possible size of a valid square-free subset.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.notes: Bitmask state transition tracking maximum subset size over primes up to 30.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Checking all 2^n subsets is exponential and intractable for large arrays.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Table of size 1024 stores max subset sizes for each prime combination.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Models prime factors as bitmasks and maximizes subset size via bitwise DP.
